chapter_title_en: The Daoist's Treachery and Millennia of Silence
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Chapter 0590 – The Seclusion of Thirteen Millennia
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen returns to the Nine Provinces, captures a clone of Xu Tian, and enters a seclusion lasting over thirteen thousand years. Witness the end of a civilization cycle and his breakthrough to Super Ancestral God.
og_title: Chapter 0590 – Thirteen Thousand Years of Cultivation
og_description: After capturing a stone spear, Xiao Chen goes underground for millennia. He becomes a Super Ancestral God, endures the end of a world, and awakens to a modern age.
twitter_description: Xiao Chen spends thirteen thousand years cultivating in the Nine Provinces, witnessing the rise and fall of civilizations. A new era dawns as archaeologists dig up ancient artifacts.
